target.name: WISE 0855
target.note: Search center supplied in the NASA challenge text. CDS returns a different astrometric position; do not mix positions without reference epochs.

catalogue.adql:
SELECT TOP 201 source_id, ra, dec, ref_epoch, pmra, pmdec, parallax, phot_g_mean_mag, DISTANCE(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),POINT('ICRS',133.795129166667,-7.245147222222)) AS search_distance_deg
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',133.795129166667,-7.245147222222,0.135947583125))
ORDER BY search_distance_deg, source_id
